entries.04d5cfa606d02c45: Companies in Japan and overseas seeking to expand overseas or grow sales channels
entries.075016599fc31d1d: Individuals who use damage insurance claim support services
entries.725ef31c0742b1a5: A company that provides global marketing support, such as SEO and search-linked advertising, to support companies' overseas expansion, and operates its own media.
entries.9bba7455ace860d3: It provides companies in Japan and overseas, in Japanese and multiple languages, with various services supporting their marketing activities, including SEM (search engine marketing) services, sales and creation of internet advertising, website development, and social media. For Google Ads, it has a sales agency agreement with Google LLC. In June 2025, it began providing “AIO Consulting,” an SEO consulting support service for websites compatible with AI search.
entries.e365748413950fcd: It is a single-segment business conducted by the group consisting of the company and four consolidated subsidiaries. It runs global marketing, which provides companies in Japan and overseas with various services supporting their marketing activities in Japanese and multiple languages, and media marketing, which leverages know-how from operating its own websites. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥254 million. It has consolidated subsidiaries in Singapore and the Philippines as overseas bases, and the consolidated subsidiaries in Thailand and Vietnam are undergoing liquidation.
entries.e464ccd22579431b: Individuals who use the company's own media
entries.f46f365ff3049fa8: It operates media that leverages know-how in building and running its own websites. To diversify its revenue sources, in July 2025 it took over the damage insurance claim support service “Mierumo” from Kurasapo Co., Ltd. and started operating it.
